response.what_it_is: A pair of car headlamp assemblies
visible_condition: Mounting tabs appear intact on one, partial on the other
hidden_risks: Whether the mounting tabs/brackets are fully intact and not cracked
Moisture seal integrity (potential for internal fogging)
Whether they are OEM or aftermarket replacements
Condition of bulb sockets and wiring connectors on the back
response.failure_mode: Assuming both headlamps are OEM and free of hairline cracks or broken mounting tabs from a top-down photo.
